title: Rooted: Finding Steady Ground
speaker: Pastor James Cole
description: What does it mean to be rooted in Christ when life feels unsteady? Pastor James opens up Colossians 2 to show us how a grounded faith grows.

title: Rooted: The Soil of Community
speaker: Pastor Naomi Cole
description: Faith was never meant to grow alone. A look at what the early church can teach us about real community.

title: Rooted: Weathering the Storms
speaker: Pastor James Cole
description: Storms reveal what we've built on. A practical message on building a life on a firm foundation.

title: Grace for the Weary
speaker: Guest Speaker: Dr. Elias Munroe
description: A tender message for anyone running on empty — an invitation to rest in grace.
